scope: Restore opt-in Codex same-conversation warming through a native local owner, registered lifecycle hooks and durable native queue; preserve native resume/permissions, exact active owner and user-input precedence. Feature SESSION-INTEGRATION, change RESUME-001. No public release or personal installation.

acceptance.description: Warming-supported interactive launches use native local --no-daemon ownership with original model/directory/permission arguments; no remote TUI, CODEX_HOME overlay, permission rewrite or production trust bypass. Unsupported/off/unready forms remain native pass-through.

Automatic timer submits exact VESTA_CACHE_KEEPALIVE with unique native client message ID to same live owner's durable queue, never types marker into terminal, resumes through a second writer or starts a turn through a second writer. Actual K and later nonce prove delivery.

Native CLI resume UUID/--last/picker and in-session /resume select intended saved conversation with native model/permissions/cwd behavior. Fresh completed reply is required before warming. Switching/navigation cancels old pre-dispatch eligibility; abandoned conversations receive no subsequent pre-dispatch ping.

Retain strict input>100000, idle20min, four-hour real-user budget, current-turn freshness, compaction invalidation, busy/disconnect skipping and pre-dispatch cancellation. Warm queue client identity never renews actual keyboard activity budget. Post-native-dispatch cancellation limits remain explicit.

Native lifecycle events must bind per-launch owner plus exact thread/turn; foreign/stale/unknown events and conflicting owners fail closed. Observer failure disables warming without disrupting native conversation. Only owned child processes are cleaned up.

Native Codex plugin installation/migration is reversible and ownership safe, preserves recorded native command, warming preferences, existing user hooks and unrelated config. Missing/untrusted/disabled hooks cannot claim active warming. Existing Claude integration remains unchanged.
Preserve native parser errors, supported native permission precedence and forwarding for noninteractive, explicit remote and unverified forms.

Development standalone binary installs and runs equivalent native warming/resume in isolated home without requiring an external Node runtime; source/native/plugin identities and raw evidence are retained.

Bounded real E2E preserves raw hook/queue/rollout/transcript proof, actual model-turn counts, personal-file hashes and owned cleanup. Native quota/auth failures remain honest blocked/failed verification, never replaced with claimed success.
